capability.summary: Preserve note envelopes when correcting half-tempo songs. Explicit user instruction to complete the conversion authorizes product work despite the default GA-only scope. Expose sequenced note length in the GUI and API, persist it, and use it consistently in playback and exports.

controls.description: Per-track note length in 1–64 sixteenth-note steps, with one step for legacy songs; accessible through the GUI and setTrackAdsr.
controls.test: Chrome GUI persistence/export/import/reset, invalid API/file rejection, mobile control visibility.

controls.description: Doubling BPM, onset indices and note length preserves envelopes, including the Voyetra lead, bass and open hat. MIDI remains governed by note-off.
controls.test: Actual PCM comparisons for all nine track indices, live source scheduling durations, full-song render comparison and captured settings. Real LE FEU RESTE sample WAV comparison.

controls.description: Offline allocation includes long final envelope tails in loop and full-song exports.
controls.test: Audible final note more than one second past the last step in phrase and song buffers; full WAV/MP3 re-export of converted song.

fixtures: All nine envelope tracks at 65 BPM / one step versus 130 BPM / two steps
Short release bass and hats, long release chords and lead
Invalid lengths 0, negative, 65, fractions and non-finite values; legacy defaults
Live playback note starts/stops; export snapshot during subsequent edits
Full LE FEU RESTE with all nine unchanged sample files
